connectors.description: Store Jev Choice, Score and Noul decisions with probabilities, input fingerprints and model provenance. Inference runs in your producer using a separate TypeSafe API key.
connectors.name: TypeSafe Jev

connectors.description: Store output tensors, masks, actions and checkpoint provenance from your model process.
connectors.name: JEPA outputs

connectors.description: Generic multi-level latent contract with parent IDs and prediction horizons; no upstream-specific architecture assumed.
connectors.name: Hierarchical JEPA

connectors.description: Multimodal transitions, structured actions, rewards and independent terminated/truncated flags. Simulator restoration requires an external complete-state codec.
connectors.name: Gymnasium

connectors.description: Episode transitions converted by the local producer. Existing CLI supports the documented Gridworld codec; generalized native conversion remains separate.
connectors.name: Minari

connectors.description: Timestamped signal chunks, markers and explicit gaps. Existing Rust LSL float32 acquisition remains available separately.
connectors.name: Lab Streaming Layer

connectors.description: EEG tensors with channel names, units and source-clock timestamps, prepared by the local Python MNE reader.
connectors.name: MNE recorded EEG

connectors.description: Normalized episode records with binary image/video assets. Existing v3 CLI exports joint vectors; native media dataset conversion is not provided by this endpoint.
connectors.name: LeRobot

connectors.description: Normalized message records. Existing Rust bag reader handles JointState; other native message decoders require local conversion.
connectors.name: ROS 2 / MCAP

connectors.description: Preserve circuit source as an opaque asset. The existing Rust parser supports its documented static unitary subset; uploading source never executes it.
connectors.name: OpenQASM

connectors.description: Circuit source and result provenance exported by your Qiskit process; no QPU connection or executable DAG is inferred.
connectors.name: Qiskit

connectors.description: Circuit artifacts and measurement results exported by your Cirq process.
connectors.name: Cirq

connectors.description: Locally acquired BrainFlow channel matrices with explicit units and board provenance. Synthetic board is tested; physical board support depends on your installed BrainFlow driver.
connectors.name: BrainFlow / OpenBCI

connectors.description: A Python host stores Q# source, QIR artifacts and local simulation results. The database never executes quantum programs or contacts a QPU.
connectors.name: Q# / QDK

connectors.description: Counts or observables from caller-run PennyLane, Braket or other quantum runtimes, with explicit basis and execution provenance. No provider authentication or job execution.
connectors.name: Portable quantum results

connectors.description: Named NumPy/PyTorch output tensors with model and checkpoint identifiers; usable for ONNX or other runtimes after local conversion. This does not load models.
connectors.name: Named model outputs

connectors.description: Observation/action/reward transitions exported by caller-run robotics or simulation environments. Isaac, MuJoCo and other producers must supply their own complete-state codecs.
connectors.name: Physical AI transitions

connectors.description: Versioned records, tensors, binary assets and temporal graph relationships.
connectors.name: Custom records

x-connector-catalog.execution: external producers; normalized transport does not load models or execute uploaded files
